doc: One kind of thing a layer places (design/plotter.md, Vocabulary). The plot system knows it only by id: the plotter maps ids to pipelines and parameters.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The kind's index in the plotter's kind table.

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: Relative weight when a candidate picks its kind.

fields.name: footprint_m
fields.doc: Radius of the ground contact the kind needs at its largest age, metres (0: no footprint, it blocks nothing: flowers).

fields.name: footprint_cells
fields.doc: Its footprint on the hex grid: 0 (none), 1, 7, 19, or 37 cells.

fields.name: max_share
fields.doc: At most this share of the layer's things in a region (1: no cap).

fields.name: ground
fields.doc: Bits of the grounds this kind accepts (bit n: ground n; 0 accepts the layer's).
